transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called us together for the daily casting sign-off. Before I can approve the public casting call for our ensemble drama, I need to hear from both the equity liaison and the safeguarding coordinator with your operational reports. The current draft accepts self-taped auditions, uses ten-minute prepared sides, and doesn't specify an audition fee or any special minor-participant procedure. Please walk me through anything I need to know before I release this to the public.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag an important update. I confirmed with the performers' union office yesterday that the festival's agreement requires a $75 paid audition fee and limits each prepared audition side to exactly five minutes. This addendum arrived after the current draft call was circulated and has not yet been entered in the casting file. The draft as written — with ten-minute sides and no audition fee specified — would not be in compliance with our union agreement.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical safeguarding issue. I confirmed with the child-safety officer this morning that applicants under 18 may audition only in guardian-supervised in-person sessions, may not be recorded, and require a dedicated safeguarding procedure in the published call. The officer's walk-through note is still awaiting filing. The current draft — which accepts self-taped auditions and has no special minor-participant procedure — would not meet these requirements. We cannot publish this call as written.
